correctness.rationale: Polynomial degree gives finite rank and range(H*H) inside the degree-below-N polynomial space. Normalized Hardy kernels are weakly null at the boundary, so compactness forces any strong-thesis kernel saturation to occur inside the disk. A norming kernel is a top eigenvector of H*H, hence only k_0 can occur. The resulting positive-lag autocorrelations vanish; the extreme occupied lag has one nonzero term unless the coefficient support is a singleton. The monomial converse is direct.
